title: Single Environmental Sector Regulatory Decree
body: Consolidates most environmental regulations in Colombia. Defines licenses, permits, plans, and competent authorities.

title: Color codes for recyclable waste
body: National standard for source separation: white (recyclable), black (non-recyclable), green (organic).

title: Post-consumer plan for Waste Electrical and Electronic Equipment
body: Requires producers and importers to submit management, operation, coverage, and target plans.

title: WEEE Law
body: Extended producer responsibility framework. Defines principles, stakeholders, selective collection, and recovery.

title: Integral management of construction and demolition waste (CDW)
body: Applies to companies that fit out offices, data centers, or warehouses: management plan, registration, and reporting.

title: Environmental management plan for packaging waste
body: Obligation for producers and marketers of packaging placed on the Colombian market.

title: Use and exploitation of water resources
body: Water concessions, discharge permits, retributive rates, and water use rates.

title: Allowable emission standards
body: Applies to stationary sources. Relevant for assemblers, data centers with generators, processes with furnaces.

title: Maximum limit parameters for point discharges
body: Defines what can be discharged to a water body or sewage system. Treatment plants, labs, data centers.

title: Environmental penalty regime (Law 1333)
body: Establishes the penalty procedure and criteria for determining fines.
